name: Tyler Crump

lede.value: I build the parts of games that have to keep working when everything else changes — and I like it when everything changes.

intro.value: Most of my work sits under the surface: the systems that hold a level together, and the editor tools that let a designer build twenty rooms instead of two. I work in Unity and C#, with FMOD for audio.

strongestSkill.value: Designing and building the systems a puzzle game runs on — switching the world between eras, puzzle generators, save state and playtest tooling.

body.value: I like games where the rules are the level. My flagship project, A Course In Time, is a puzzle-platformer about one building across time — so most of what I've built is the machinery underneath: the switch between eras, the generators that make puzzles, the save system that remembers them, and the tools that let other people test them.
